title: incident-bot: on-call runbook linking and SLO-context helpers
author: Elena Park
release_notes: Adds automatic runbook suggestion links in incident-bot based on SLO context; introduces new SLO toolkit helpers for extracting service/owner metadata; updates docs and tests.
description: Motivation: On recent oncall rotations we found it takes manual effort to surface the best runbooks when SLOs fail — runbook links are often generic or missing service-specific context. This PR enhances incident-bot to provide smarter runbook linking and on-call helper suggestions by leveraging new slo-toolkit utilities and SLO context signals. Summary: 1) incident-bot now ranks candidate runbooks using SLO metadata (service, owning-team, symptom tags) and returns the top 3 links as part of the oncall payload. 2) Added slo-toolkit helpers (slo_context_extractor, runbook_ranker) that encapsulate extraction of service/owner labels from SLI/SLO records and a lightweight TF-IDF + tag-match ranking used by incident-bot. 3) Runbook suggestion UI in the Slack oncall message was updated to show prioritized links and a short rationale. 4) Added feature flag incident_bot.runbook_linking to gate rollout. 5) Tests, unit coverage, and docs for the new helpers and the incident-bot behavior. Implementation details: - New module: packages/slo-toolkit/src/runbook_ranker.py (pure Python; dependency-free) - incident-bot handlers updated: services/incident_bot/oncall_helpers.py now calls slo-toolkit to get suggestions and attaches suggested links to oncall messages. - Introduced a lightweight cache with a 5m TTL to avoid repeated score computation on a noisy alert stream. - Added telemetry: incidents.runbook_suggestion.count, incidents.runbook_suggestion.latency_ms, incidents.runbook_suggestion.accept_rate. Rollout plan: feature flag enabled initially for internal teams only, monitor metrics for false positives and click-through. If stable after 2 weeks, enable for all hosted customers. Checklist: - [x] Implementation completed - [x] Unit tests added/updated - [x] Integration test for Slack message format - [x] Docs updated (runbooks.md + incident-bot README) - [x] Feature flag present - [x] Telemetry emitted - [x] Reviewed and approved by Priya and Marco

Marco Liu: One nit: runbook_ranker currently does an O(n*m) tag-match in Python; can we add a simple growth note or docstring about expected candidate sizes? Also please increment telemetry to capture when no runbooks are found.
